note: No retraining, no DVC pull, no downloads, no new data collection.

ablations.constant_velocity: No visual model; extrapolates recent ego-motion linearly.
ablations.zero_visual_tokens: Sets all cached visual tokens to zero before the model.
ablations.static_visual_tokens: Repeats the last frame token grid across the whole history.
ablations.no_temporal_adapter: Skips the TimeSFormer-style temporal/spatial fusion adapter.
ablations.uniform_selector: Replaces adaptive TokenLearner cues with repeated spatial means.
ablations.no_cue_temporal: Skips temporal modeling over selected cue tokens.
ablations.no_memory_update: Bypasses the cue memory bank and decodes from the last cue set.
ablations.no_ego_memory: Zeros ego-motion only inside memory updates; keeps the final CV base intact.

dino_off_ego_only.meaning: No DINO, no visual model; ego-motion-only extrapolation.

dino_signal_off_same_checkpoint.meaning: Same trained model, but cached DINO tokens are replaced by zeros at inference.
